title: WPMS/857/2018 of Kalyan Singh Jeena Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No. 857 of 2018
Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. P.C. Petshali, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. N.S. Pundir, Deputy Advocate
General for the State of Uttarakhand/respondent
nos. 1, 2 & 4.
Mr. Mukesh Kaparwan, Advocate
holding brief of Mr. Rakesh Thapliyal,
Advocate for respondent no. 3.
The petitioner has filed this writ petition
praying for to connect a tube-well (RG-48) with
the drinking pipe line of the water supply
system as resolved by the resolution dated
05.05.2017.
Initially this Court had called the counter
affidavit from the respondents, and in response
thereto, the respondent no. 4 has filed a counter
affidavit, wherein, he has annexed a letter dated
23.04.2018, wherein, a following statement has
been made:

On a simple interpretation of this letter,
the Executive Engineer has made a statement
that the village in question has been connected
with the water pipe line.
In view of the aforesaid letter and the
pleading as raised in the counter affidavit and
considering it in the light of the relief sought
for in the writ petition, the village in question
has been connected with the water pipe line as
detailed in the letter dated 23.04.2018.

It is argued by the learned counsel for the
petitioner that though the water pipe line has
already been connected, but there is no water
supply, which is being provided to the village
in question.
With regards to that the learned counsel
for respondent no. 3 has made a categoric
statement before this Court that water is being
supplied to the village in question in phases, i.e.
supply is maintained for two hours in the
morning and two hours in the evening.
The said statement made by the learned
counsel for respondent no. 3 is taken on record,
and in case if the supply is not maintained in
accordance with the statement recorded, it will
be open with the petitioner to re-approach the
Court for seeking an appropriate remedy.
Subject to the above observation, the writ
petition stands disposed of.
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 30.05.2019
Pooja
